mission.title: argo: Allow to define prune by default for manual sync applications
mission.description: Allow to define prune by default for manual sync applications. Requested by 67+ users.

steps.title: Check current argo deployment
steps.description:
Verify your argo version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
helm list -n argo 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working argo installation.

steps.title: Review argo configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant argo configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
kubectl get configmap -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argo
```
For applications not defined with automated sync, I'd still like to define (declaratively in the YAML) that the manual sync should use pruning.

Currently pruning implies automated sync:
```
spec:
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for Allow to define prune by default for manual sync…
steps.description:
In our use case, the issue is that we want `prune` to be enabled, but we lose it every time one rolls back (as automated is emptied during rollbacks and the settings are lost).

Decouple `prune` from `automated` so it also applies to manual syncs. Two proposed shapes from the issue discussion — a top-level `prune` flag:
```yaml
spec:
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      enabled: <boolean>
      selfHeal: <boolean>
    prune: <boolean>
```
or an explicit `manual` sync policy block:
```yaml
spec:
  syncPolicy:
    manual:
      prune: true
      dryRun: false
      applyOnly: false
      force: false
```
Set the declarative prune option in your Application manifest so manual syncs prune by default and the setting survives rollbacks.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n argo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=argo
kubectl get events -n argo --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Allow to define prune by default for manual sync…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: In our use case, the issue is that we want `prune` to be enabled, but we lose it every time one rolls back (as automated is emptied during rollbacks and the settings are lost).
codeSnippets:
spec:
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
        enabled: <boolean>
        selfHeal: <boolean>
    prune: <boolean>

spec:
  syncPolicy:
    manual:
      prune: true
      dryRun: false
      applyOnly: false
      force: false

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with argo installed or the issue environment reproducible.
